_about: Named review views of the Chapter 2 scene, shared by the dev review panel (?dev=1&view=NAME) and tools/tests/review_shots.js. 'at' is story time: seconds, or a timeline mark from the scene (lid0, lidGo, door1 …) with an optional offset like 'lidGo+0.8'. 'pos'/'look' are town units; camera 'story' uses the visitor's own shot (desktop or phone composition) instead.

hall-front.note: the Community Hall sign and both upper windows, straight on

hall-angle.note: the sign at an angle, both upper windows and their shutters

lid-closed.note: the drop-off box, lid shut, the Marine's hand at the lip

lid-half.note: the lid half open, from the side

lid-open-side.note: the lid fully open, edge-on: it must stop short of the sign

lid-open.note: the open lid and the sign behind it, from the street

lid-story.note: the visitor's own shot at that moment (desktop or phone)

doorway.note: the hall door open, the lit entrance room behind it

doorway-story.note: the visitor's own shot of the open door

donation-story.note: the child holds the truck up over the box (the visitor's shot)

drop-story.note: the truck goes through the slot (the visitor's shot)

glow-story.note: the box glows, the child looks up (the visitor's wide shot)

box-front.note: the drop-off box from the street: paint, trims, the slot glow

snow-low.note: low over the drifts by the box: snow surface and feet

room-overview.note: the sorting room from high in the front-right corner

room-left.note: the sorting room from the front-left corner

room-back.note: looking back at the front wall: windows, door, coats

sort-window-out.note: nearing the hall's lit window (the visitor's shot)

sort-enter-story.note: the Marine brings the carton to the table

sort-reveal-story.note: the red truck lifted into the lamplight

sort-check-story.note: the truck looked over (tipped to see its wheels)

sort-crate-story.note: the truck laid in the crate of prepared toys

sort-room-story.note: the room at work, the back door opening

sort-handoff-story.note: the cart at the open back door: the hand-off

sort-glass.note: the lens at the window glass (the warm glow)

sort-arrive-story.note: inside: the Marine walks to the table
